name: nexqueue-workspace
description: Distributed job queue workspace with BullMQ and Redis

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix user-service && npm install --prefix order-server && npm install --prefix mail-server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "user,order,mail" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix user-service" "npm run dev --prefix order-server" "npm run dev --prefix mail-server"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "user,order,mail" -c "cyan,green,magenta" "npm run start --prefix user-service" "npm run start --prefix order-server" "npm run start --prefix mail-server"
